method: AI-assisted rule-based draft, not an independent human-reviewed gold standard. Internal sentence boundaries only, within the prose chunks passed by Leaves to sentence_spans. Offsets are exclusive Unicode character ends in assembled text. Chunk ends excluded. Non-TeX and parser failures reported separately. P/R/F1 are micro averages.
review_note: AI contextual corrections cover initials, abbreviated addresses, numbered labels, and sentence-final appendix/model names. Only the explicitly marked paragraph has user review. Other labels remain provisional.
